fcboard.选择 / 圈选：再次点击切换框选与套索: Select: tap again to switch between rectangle and lasso
fcboard.多点：多人同时书写；单点：仅接收一处笔迹。选择或移动工具可双指缩放: Multi: write together. Single: accept one contact. Pinch to zoom with Select or Hand.
fcboard.网页可关闭当前标签页: Close this browser tab to exit
fcboard.请选择计时器或动态实验: Select a timer or animated experiment
fcboard.当前设备没有这项大屏工具: This tool is not installed on this display
fcboard.正在打开大屏工具，请稍候: Opening the display tool, please wait
fcboard.当前设备未提供出厂工具，可继续使用白板教具。: No factory tools are available. Whiteboard tools can still be used.
fcboard.用逗号或换行分开: Separate with commas or new lines
fcboard.当前设备未安装信号源应用: The signal app is not installed on this display
fcboard.请先选择表格、思维导图或四线格: Select a table, mind map or four-line grid first
fcboard.当前设备未提供信号源应用: No signal app is available on this display
fcboard.单元格内容（每行一行，列以 Tab 分隔）: Cells (one row per line, columns separated by tabs)
fcboard.导图大纲（每两空格缩进一层）: Outline (indent each level by two spaces)
fcboard.选区没有可识别的内容: The selection has no recognizable content
fcboard.生成插图请先在设置中填写图像生成模型 ID: Set an image model ID in settings before generating illustrations
fcboard.未识别到内容，请重新圈选: No content recognized. Select the area again.
fcboard.分享已到期，可重新生成二维码: Sharing expired. Generate a new QR code.
fcboard.扫码下载所选页面，十分钟后失效；关闭窗口即结束分享: Scan to download the selected pages. Expires in ten minutes or when this window closes.
fcboard.当前浏览器不支持附件分享，请下载页面后在邮件中添加附件: This browser cannot share attachments. Download the pages and attach them to your email.
fcboard.已打开系统邮件 / 分享窗口，请选择收件应用并确认发送: Choose an app in the system share window and confirm sending.
fcboard.Android 大屏支持同一局域网扫码下载；此处可直接导出页面。: Android displays support QR downloads on the same network. You can export pages here.
fcboard.{{name}}：停笔后识别，原笔迹在识别完成前保留: {{name}}: recognized after writing pauses; original ink is kept until recognition finishes
fcboard.暂无文稿。可配置自定义语音接口后转写，也可手动补充。: No transcript yet. Use a custom speech service or add notes manually.
fcboard.识别模型 ID（留空使用主模型）: OCR model ID (blank to use the main model)
fcboard.快速问答模型 ID（留空使用主模型）: Fast answer model ID (blank to use the main model)
fcboard.填写已开通的 Seedream 模型 ID: Enter an enabled Seedream model ID
fcboard.中文模型随安卓版安装，识别在本机完成，不依赖系统语音服务。录制文稿与录音共用同一: The Chinese model is bundled with Android. Recognition runs locally and shares the recording microphone.
fcboard.接口需支持 multipart 音频上传与 text / segments（st: The endpoint must accept multipart audio and return text or segments (start, text). Browser access requires CORS.
fcboard.安卓版留空使用内置离线中英文播报；浏览器使用系统声音。填写接口可替换播报引擎。: On Android, leave empty for bundled offline Chinese/English narration. Browsers use system voices. Set an endpoint to override the engine.
fcboard.在本机记住密钥（共享教学设备建议关闭）: Remember keys on this device (avoid on shared displays)
fcboard.跟随选区颜色、字号与字体: Match the selection colour, size and font
fcboard.圈选后点击计算、图像或问答才会识别；普通书写不会触发 AI 请求。: Recognition starts only after selecting Calculate, Image or Questions. Ordinary writing makes no AI request.
fcboard.AI 截图、语音或录制转写会发送至你配置的服务。系统语音是否联网取决于设备语音服: AI images, speech and transcripts are sent to your configured service. System speech may use the network.
fcboard.分析整个白板（关闭时优先使用框选区域）: Analyze the whole board (otherwise prefer the selection)
fcboard.帮我画个立方体 / 画 y=x+1 / 总结这一板: Draw a cube / plot y=x+1 / summarize this board
fcboard.x、y 控制采样区间的平移，z 控制输出偏移；a、b、c 可用于表达式。拖动后更: x and y shift the sampled domain; z shifts the output. Expressions can use a, b and c. Changes update the graph.
fcboard.录制时可关闭此浮层继续使用白板。屏幕模式采集白板画面，组合模式将摄像头叠放在右下: Close this panel to keep writing while recording. Board mode captures the canvas; combined mode adds the camera at the bottom right.
fcboard.补充文稿（每行一段，可用 00:30 文字）: Add transcript (one paragraph per line, optional 00:30 timestamp)
fcboard.尚未选择录制资料。录制会保存在当前设备，可回放和下载。: Select a recording to play or download it. Recordings are saved on this device.
fcboard.安卓大屏与手机连接同一局域网，开启后使用手机浏览器打开接收地址。关闭后地址立即失: Connect the display and phone to the same network. Open the receiving address on your phone. Closing transfer disables the address.
fcboard.局域网接收服务在安卓安装版提供；浏览器版可打开本机文件。: Local receiving is available in the Android app. The browser can open local files.
fcboard.还没有收到文件。手机选中文件即上传上屏，支持 PPT / PPTX、PDF、Wo: No files received yet. Upload from your phone: PPT / PPTX, PDF, Word, Excel and images are supported.
fcboard.网页由资源提供方加载；若禁止嵌入，请使用“浏览器打开”。: This page is loaded by its provider. If embedding is blocked, choose Open in browser.
fcboard.暂无总结，可在下方生成。: No summary yet. Generate one below.
fcboard.请先在 AI 设置中填写 API 密钥和支持视觉的模型 ID / 接入点 ID: Set an API key and a vision model or endpoint ID in AI settings
fcboard.未能可靠识别选区。请缩小圈选范围，或在设置中选择云端手写识别。: The selection could not be read reliably. Select a smaller area or choose cloud handwriting recognition in settings.
fcboard.函数可直接绘制；生成插图请先在设置中填写图像生成模型 ID: Functions can be plotted directly. Set an image model ID in settings to generate illustrations.
fcboard.图像生成需要兼容方舟 /api/v3 接口地址: Image generation requires an Ark-compatible /api/v3 endpoint
fcboard.请检查图像模型与权限: Check the image model and permissions
fcboard.图像服务未返回有效图片: The image service returned no valid image
fcboard.图像服务返回了不支持的图片格式: The image service returned an unsupported format
fcboard.设备存储不足或不可用，录制尚未保存；请立即下载保留。: Storage is full or unavailable. Download the recording now to keep it.
fcboard.请先书写内容，或框选需要识别的区域: Write something or circle the area to recognize first
fcboard.计算结果已写入白板，可撤销或擦除: Result added to the board. You can undo or erase it.
fcboard.图像已被移动到历史或擦除，请重新插入函数图像: This plot was removed. Insert it again to edit it.
fcboard.函数图像已插入；调节参数可观察变化: Plot inserted. Adjust the parameters to explore it.
fcboard.总结已写入白板，可编辑、撤销或擦除: Summary added to the board. You can edit, undo or erase it.
fcboard.标准线条立方体已插入，可编辑或擦除: Cube inserted. You can edit or erase it.
fcboard.AI 指令格式无效，请重试: Invalid AI command. Please try again.
fcboard.图形已写入白板，可编辑、撤销或擦除: Shapes added to the board. You can edit, undo or erase them.
fcboard.回答已写入白板，可编辑、撤销或擦除: Answer added to the board. You can edit, undo or erase it.
fcboard.AI 返回了无法执行的操作，请重新描述: AI returned an unavailable action. Please rephrase your request.
fcboard.录制中请使用文字指令，避免与录音争用麦克风: Use text commands while recording to keep the microphone available.
fcboard.未识别到语音，请重试: No speech recognized. Please try again.
fcboard.正在听，停顿后执行指令；也可再次点击结束语音: Listening. Pause to run your command, or tap again to stop.
fcboard.语音录入失败，请重试: Speech input failed. Please try again.
fcboard.正在听，请说出指令后再次点击语音按钮: Listening. Say your command, then tap the microphone again.
fcboard.当前录制正在进行或保存中: A recording is running or being saved
fcboard.录制中，可关闭浮层继续书写；屏幕模式录制当前白板画面: Recording. Close this panel to keep writing. Screen mode records the current board.
fcboard.退出应用需要 Android 安装版；网页可关闭当前标签页: Close this browser tab to exit. App exit is available on Android.
fcboard.局域网接收服务需要安卓安装版: LAN file receiving requires the Android app
fcboard.未找到课件，请先在本机课件中重新打开原文件: File not found. Open the original file again from local files.
fcboard.复制失败，请手动抄写接收地址: Could not copy. Copy the receiving address manually.
fcboard.课件可播放，资料索引保存失败: Playback is available, but the resource index could not be saved.
fcboard.文件中没有可显示的页面: This file has no displayable pages
fcboard.课件可预览，资料索引保存失败: Preview is available, but the resource index could not be saved.
fcboard.板书尚未保存，请稍后重试: Annotations have not been saved. Please try again shortly.
fcboard.板书尚未保存，课件保持打开: Annotations have not been saved. Keep this file open.
fcboard.课件缩放范围为50%到300%: Document zoom must be between 50% and 300%
fcboard.请先圈选要擦除的板书；原课件内容不会被擦除: Circle annotations to erase first. The original document is preserved.
fcboard.课件上可使用笔、橡皮或圈选；也可直接说要插入的文字或图形: Use the pen, eraser or lasso on the document, or describe text or shapes to insert.
fcboard.课件板书可调整颜色、笔宽、字号与透明度: You can adjust annotation color, pen width, text size and opacity.
fcboard.板书样式超出范围: Annotation style value out of range
fcboard.笔画宽度必须在1到30之间: Pen width must be between 1 and 30
fcboard.板书文本为空或过长: Annotation text is empty or too long
fcboard.对这页说点什么: Give a command about this page
fcboard.请在安卓大屏开启协作，再用其他设备扫描二维码加入: Start collaboration on the Android board, then scan the QR code on another device.
fcboard.连接中断，重连后会自动补同步: Connection interrupted. Changes will sync after reconnection.
fcboard.同一局域网扫码加入，书写、图片与撤销实时同步。: Scan on the same network to join. Writing, images and undo sync live.
fcboard.请用此设备扫描安卓大屏的协作二维码，直接加入白板。: Scan the Android board's collaboration QR code with this device to join.
fcboard.手机浏览器控制整个大屏，可切换应用、翻页和书写。先在大屏开启无线调试，再用手机完: Control the board from your phone browser: switch apps, turn pages and write. Enable wireless debugging on the board, then pair your phone.
fcboard.短步骤 · 每步停顿: Short steps · Pause after each step
fcboard.讲解记录保存失败，白板内容仍在当前板上: Could not save the lesson record. Your board content is preserved.
fcboard.请说出想学的内容，或选中题目后提问: Say what you want to learn, or select a question to ask about it.
fcboard.正在阅读白板，准备讲解…: Reading the board and preparing your lesson…
fcboard.字幕讲解中 · 语音播报暂不可用: Teaching with captions · Voice playback is unavailable
fcboard.讲讲我圈的这一步，或换个例子…: Explain the step I circled, or use another example…
fcboard.请输入完整的 http 或 https 网页地址: Enter a complete http or https website address
fcboard.教学资源不存在，请先读取资源清单: Resource not found. Load the resource list first.
fcboard.无法读取教学资源，请检查安装文件: Could not read teaching resources. Check the installation.
fcboard.AI 请求了当前不可用的操作，请重新描述: AI requested an unavailable action. Please rephrase your request.
fcboard.连续操作达到上限，已完成的内容已保留，可继续描述下一步: Action limit reached. Completed work is preserved. Describe the next step to continue.
fcboard.连续观察达到上限，已完成的内容已保留，可继续描述下一步: Observation limit reached. Completed work is preserved. Describe the next step to continue.
fcboard.选区位于课件显示范围之外，请重新圈选: Selection is outside the visible document. Circle the area again.
fcboard.选区缺少有效边界，请重新圈选笔迹: Selection bounds are invalid. Circle the writing again.
fcboard.请指定是否显示工具栏: Specify whether to show the toolbar
fcboard.这项操作用于白板；在课件上可翻页、板书、圈选、撤销或直接说要插入的内容: This action is for the board. In a document, turn pages, annotate, circle, undo or describe what to insert.
fcboard.笔画宽度必须在 1 到 30 之间: Pen width must be between 1 and 30
fcboard.文本为空或过长: Text is empty or too long
